channel.title: Our State Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Our State Magazine (ourstate.com)

item.title: Home & Board
item.description: For nearly 30 years, the owners of Durham’s Morehead Manor Bed and Breakfast have shared their historic home with travelers they treat like family.

item.title: Teatime in Shelby
item.description: In Cleveland County, the owner of a beloved home has restored its former grandeur and reinstated its tradition of hospitality through afternoon teas.

item.title: Care & Keeping
item.description: With each guest she welcomes, a steward of the historic Lovill House honors the home’s legacy — and her own family’s High Country roots.

item.title: Jewelry That Lasts a Lifetime
item.description: A Triad-based jeweler shares six expert tips to help you preserve your most precious pieces.

item.title: Susan’s Promise
item.description: A mother’s vision transformed a Whitsett farm into a place where differences dissolve, friendships flourish, and every life — even a barn cat’s — shines on.

item.title: 9 Coastal Restaurants That’ll Welcome You in the Off-Season
item.description: In the colder months, our beach towns settle for a long winter’s nap. If you escape to enjoy the solitude, you’ll find these spots open and ready to greet you with warm plates and smiles.

item.title: 48 Hours in Edenton: A Weekend by the Water
item.description: Stay at a charming inn, eat incredible seafood, explore maritime history, take a beautiful boat ride on Edenton Bay, and more in this historic former port town on the Albemarle Sound.

item.title: Expert Tips to Prepare Your Garden for Spring
item.description: Dreaming of spring blooms? Us too. Three gardening experts share the steps you can take now to help your garden thrive in the coming months.

item.title: Your Guide to Pinehurst
item.description: Discover where to enjoy a meal, grab a drink, get outside — both on and off the green — and unwind in America’s premier golfing destination.

item.title: Magnificent Mocktails: Pure Bliss Choco-tini
item.description: Raise a glass to someone sweet with a chocolaty twist on the espresso martini that just happens to be alcohol free.
